docstring: A bounded source-compatible RTL evidence request selects the existing shipped RTL-only feature profile without requiring an operator feature file or IC/IP confirmation.
fix_action: Augment `flow109.resolve_task_manifest` and call it before public delivery admission and through the thin dispatcher's existing forwarding boundary. Reuse the standard registry profile and existing source/window checks; preserve explicit input bytes and strict feature conflicts.
before_state: Actual general entry returned DELIVERY_ROUTE_UNDECLARED and actual adapter entry returned FLOW109_MANIFEST_REQUIRED, both rc=2.
after_state: Both actual public paths reach design_one_shot_runner with bounded native entry 1 and exit 2, using exactly the shipped RTL-only profile.
ai_reasoning: The visible bounded evidence contract already determines RTL applicability. Asking the user for a profile repeats a decision the existing general contract can resolve. This is deterministic applicability, not acceptance or tool qualification.
pattern: A shared front door requires a fully explicit configuration even though its existing visible delivery and bounded evidence contract uniquely selects a shipped standard profile, producing an unnecessary user confirmation before any useful work.
generality: Normal public projects and thin evaluation adapters use the same resolver; no dataset, problem name, oracle or previous score is an input.

design: repeat of the same neutral bounded RTL task
docstring: A second ordinary invocation can reuse an unchanged standard RTL profile only after current source and bounded-window checks.
fix_action: Recognize equality to the shipped profile, preserve existing bytes, and re-run the existing source/window applicability checks before normal Flow109 request binding. Do not persist another profile-state sidecar or reuse acceptance authority.
before_state: First actual public invocation reached OWNER_REACHED; the second returned REFUSED with DELIVERY_ROUTE_UNDECLARED.
after_state: Both identical public invocations reach the owner; changed physical delivery or explicit optional feature choices refuse automatic reuse without rewriting bytes.
ai_reasoning: Existence alone must not suppress deterministic applicability resolution, and an old selection must not authorize a changed source or feature choice.
pattern: An automatically materialized input is recognized only during its creation, so the next ordinary invocation loses the same scope and asks the user to restate it.
generality: Any normal bounded RTL invocation can repeat; current source and evidence checks continue to own applicability.
